root_cause_resolutions.issue: False Positives on New-Programme applications for RULE-DOC-STATE-008
root_cause_resolutions.root_cause: State Government NOC and Building Plan were only generated for specific defect indices rather than as baseline files for all non-defective New-Programme applicants.
root_cause_resolutions.resolution: Implemented baseline generation of valid NOC-State Govt and Building Plan documents for all regular New-Programme institutions, leaving only index 30 as missing.

root_cause_resolutions.issue: False Negative on Sunrise Institute for RULE-ANOM-DUPDOC-006 (Duplicate Fire NOC)
root_cause_resolutions.root_cause: Sunrise Institute (index 0) executed before Pioneer Institute (index 6), resulting in saved_fire_noc_bytes being None during Sunrise's generation.
root_cause_resolutions.resolution: Pre-generated the shared Fire Safety NOC bytes before the institutional loop, ensuring identical SHA-256 byte fingerprints for both institutions.

root_cause_resolutions.issue: False Negative on Sunrise Institute for RULE-DOC-AFFL-002 (Tampered validity date)
root_cause_resolutions.root_cause: The rule engine only verified the printed date against current time, omitting cross-check with the cryptographic QR payload.
root_cause_resolutions.resolution: Extended validity check to inspect signed cryptographic records and flag 'printed validity date differs from the signed record'.

root_cause_resolutions.issue: False Positive on Silver Oak Institute (APP-2026-SOI10) for RULE-INFR-PHOTO-007
root_cause_resolutions.root_cause: The generator matched 'Computer' in the institution name ('Silver Oak Institute of Computer Sciences') causing all four rooms to draw identical computer lab screens.
root_cause_resolutions.resolution: Refactored drawing branch to check facility_type strictly rather than institution name, and added distinct structural landmarks per room.
